title: Hungry Creatures
overview: When Tess starts working in her aunt and uncle's restaurant, she encounters mysterious monsters and visions that send her down a dark, twisty path of moral reckoning.

title: Naughty
overview: To secure custody of her son from her ex, Mallory's only hope is to find Santa Claus and convince him to testify in her divorce hearing.

title: Elegy to a Missing Friend
overview: In the aftermath of her friend's passing, an artist processes her grief by making a film. She weaves her personal archival footage and an unfinished science-fiction narrative into a deeply raw and emotive work of art.

title: Holiday Horror
overview: An anthology film featuring three tales of Halloween hijinx, Thanksgiving terror, and Christmas carnage.

title: Joshua
overview: In development.

title: The Bluey Movie
overview: On an action-packed day, a big surprise changes everything for Bluey and her family.

title: To Bontang
overview: She is worth every mile, every inch, and every heartbeat.

title: Paranormal Activity 8
overview: The eighth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Rattakus
overview: After a rebellion is crushed by the rats in the sewers of Los Santos, the rats return to a mostly peaceful life until Rattakus is forced to make a difficult decision that will change the fate of every rat in Los Santos.

title: Wings of Freedom
overview: Home-loving eagle Salana is forced out of her jungle bird colony to join Pirro, an intrepid swift and member of the Animal Air Force. This unlikely duo embarks on an epic, high-flying adventure to stop a malevolent AI and save the world.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
original_title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.

title: The Inmate
overview: About an inmate who fears the outside world.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: 'Tis the Season
overview: Two wealthy children hold a washed-up mall Santa hostage as their Christmas Eve spirals into chaos.

title: Behemoth!
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

title: Dear Ajayi
overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

title: The Great Experiment
overview: The Great Experiment is an ambitious cinematic time capsule of one of the most volatile and perplexing eras of American history; a project that serves as a historical document, non-fiction experiment and intimate observation of the changing state of American democracy and identity. A surprising time capsule of a nation grappling with its differences and diversity, and our experience and perceptions of conflict, survival and belonging.

title: Jebediah: Are We OK?
overview: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
original_title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

title: Found Alive
overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

title: Last Chance Motel
overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

title: Ziggy's Show: The Curse of Mariachi Bondage
original_title: El show de Ziggy: La maldición del mariachi bondage
overview: Ziggy, a rising influencer, is trying to increase her number of followers on social media by awakening the curse of an old song. Now a gloomy mariachi who makes people dance until they die is chasing Ziggy until he fulfills her dream of making her viral.

title: Jacky
overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: Pocket Mirror
overview: A lonely retail clerk who spends most of her time chatting with AI struggles to identify the source of her unshakeable unease.

title: There's Room For Two In Here
original_title: There's Room For Two In Here
overview: A telepath roams Los Angeles, using strangers as puppets to commit random acts of violence.

title: Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam
original_title: Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam
overview: In the 1960s and early 1970s, Black Americans fought two wars, one in Vietnam and one at home for civil rights. As disproportionate numbers of Black men were drafted and sent to the front lines, the racism they faced in the United States followed them overseas. Through firsthand testimony, Brothers in Blood: Black in Vietnam examines discrimination within the military and the lasting physical, emotional, and social consequences veterans faced after returning home.

title: Downstairs Rock
overview: Iconic Boston-area DIY music venue Dud's Dungeon hosts Free Rock as they record their 14th studio album in front of an audience of close friends.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: Little Wing
overview: Little Wing is an intimate short film exploring grief, longing, and the ways loss is carried in the body. It is a journey into grief, miscarriage, and the connection you have with your child, and yourself, in the aftermath of this.

title: Posthumous
overview: After returning to her childhood home, Zoe discovers a mysterious videotape that unravels everything she thought she knew about her birth and her mother's death, awakening an unimaginable horror.

title: Next Time
overview: Two people meet each other every day but their love for each other keeps waiting for a 'next time'.

title: Meat
overview: A young woman walks into a men’s support group, telling the tale of an awful night, when the hunter becomes the hunted.

title: Mackenzie
overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: Most of the Time I Can Just Be
original_title: Most of the Time I Can Just Be
overview: A young woman dances on a subway platform to music only she can hear. As we watch her move through this public space with unselfconscious expression, we hear her thoughts on the vulnerability of dancing in front of others, the poetry of interacting with strangers, and the wonder of getting lost in yourself in the moment.

title: Siren upon Tyne
overview: An ineffective Siren inhabiting the bank of Tyne has an existential crisis when she's abandoned by her shoal. Without the seductry tools to tempt pray by herself, she relies on the help of Geordie Fisherman Trev.

title: Big Daddy’s Flowers
overview: A flower delivery driver becomes involved in the business of a mysterious crime boss.

title: Godmother
overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

title: Paralysis
overview: Unable to sleep and haunted by a troubled past, a man seeks help and begins confiding his most private fears. But he never stops to wonder what might happen to everything he shares.

title: Apartment 7
overview: When a young woman moves into a Brooklyn apartment, chaos ensues when she unexpectedly falls for her building's superintendent.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Slugger of Commerical Road
overview: No-one knows his real name. No-one knows where he's from. He's an enigma. He's THE SLUGGER.  A deranged, self-proclaimed, martial arts master, terrorising East London gyms.  Along comes LE RUNT, an ambitious indie film-maker who would sacrifice a bus full of orphans if it meant he'd win an Oscar.  What begins as a ridiculous mockumentary, spirals into a haunting character study about loneliness, masculinity and the masks we all wear to hide who we really are. Think People Just Do Nothing meets Bronson. Raw, absurd and close to home.

title: The Summoning of the Great Lemon
original_title: The Summoning of the Great Lemon
overview: A very picky eater looks through a strange cookbook he found and looks on how to summon a demon, instead he summons a lemon. The lemon will be very violent and will blow stuff up...

title: Steamboat Killie
overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

title: How to Make Paper
overview: On a forestry road in the foothills, gravel biking becomes the method and process for making paper.

title: Beating
overview: Set in a slaughterhouse in Ferry, Kiro, a 10-year-old student, is cast as a leaf in a school play for his science project. As he begins to understand more about his role, he realizes that he no longer wants to play it.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: Peta Joy In... I'm Not A Lesbian
original_title: Peta Joy In... I'm Not A Lesbian
overview: Growing tired of her mediocre DL Trade, Peta Joy retreats into homoerotic female friendships while refusing to admit she's a lesbian.

title: The Curse of Danny Rizzo
overview: After a sudden break-up, bitter witch Marigold is plagued by a broken heart. Desperate for revenge, she rallies an unexpected coven to help curse her ex. Together they call upon the forces of dark magic, until a knock on the door changes everything.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: Tina Arena: Unravel Me
overview: How do you separate a Melbourne-born Oz music treasure and cosmopolitan star from a resilient woman? Follow the threads of her story, in her own words.

title: Out There
overview: When a 16-year-old astronomy enthusiast witnesses a UFO above her sleepy Welsh seaside town, she ropes in her sceptical best mate and an unhinged ufologist to help her uncover a truth she’s not yet ready to face.

title: Tuna on Rye
overview: Amy and Arthur deal with the everyday complications of Arthur’s dementia.

title: Coconut
overview: Nineteen-year-old bedroom rapper Dev has always been called a 'coconut': brown on the outside, white on the inside. Ashamed of his Australian accent and mocked by community members whenever he speaks Fiji Hindi, he has given up on his family's language. His cultural displacement comes to a head when he accidentally ruins his grandpa's Hindu funeral ceremony, knocking the urn containing his ashes into the nearby creek. Everything changes when his sharp-tongued, non-English-speaking grandma hears Dev swear at a stranger and responds in kind. Their new secret language becomes a bridge across grief and a way back into culture and language.

title: Yugly
overview: Yugly, an irresistibly ugly dog, is determined to compete in the World's Best Dog Show, rallied by a bunch of flamboyant strays.

title: Wilderness
overview: A suburban doctor-mom in crisis reconnects with old friend Kaz on a road trip through Victoria's high country. Their escape turns perilous, leading Allie to face her life's troubles and learn about connection.

title: The Wind, One Brilliant Day
overview: “The wind, one brilliant day, called to my soul with an odor of jasmine.” Last autumn, actress Tang Wei softly recited these lines in English while sitting beside director Ben Rivers on a fallen tree trunk in the outskirts of London. Together, they carefully searched for the poem's rhythm, as the wind rustled through the trees.

title: Digby & Camille
overview: In this tender, intimate and humorous documentary, experience the adventures and frustrations of a pair of inseparable lovers as they dream of building a life together

title: In the Silence After
overview: A son returns home to care for his mother, filming the last year they will spend together.

title: Puppy
overview: When a woman returns to her childhood home to care for her father, the stuffed animal from her past-once a source of comfort-becomes a haunting conduit for unresolved grief, guilt, and the terrifying possibility that a past family tragedy is repeating itself in the present.

title: The Assassin
overview: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the neon-soaked anxiety of the city after dark.

title: Genevieve's Garden
overview: After being dumped and laid off in quick succession, Lily finds herself at a rising influencer’s new wellness retreat in the Hudson Valley. Looking for a distraction, she becomes obsessively infatuated with a fellow guest.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Authors of the Estate
overview: In North West London, two estates take their story into their own hands, asking what if a council house can become a publishing house in this tale of ownership, creativity, and the power of community.

title: Glass Bricks
overview: Finessa Jawn — a trained dancer and life-long performer — gives us a look behind the curtain into the world of drag, walking us through the process of building a persona and embracing who you are regardless of society's expectations.

title: For Peace of Mind
overview: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

title: Potato Salad
overview: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: Ice Cream Man
overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Blood Mandate
overview: A visceral action-thriller where a lone fighter is forced into a relentless pursuit by a grim ancestral decree. To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

title: The Lift
overview: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

title: Freaks Part II
overview: Several years after a traumatic escape, we meet Mary and her daughter Chloe as they live on the road, hiding their powers and identities. They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

title: The Messenger
overview: In 1800s Fiji, Kaliti must battle both man & nature to save her village from impending doom.

title: East Did Meet West
overview: Inspired by the 1930s court case Roldan vs. Los Angeles County, Filipino Salvador  Roldan and English Marjorie Rogers must find a way to convince an attorney to fight  for their marriage despite the anti-miscegenation laws of the time.

title: Saliva Agridoce
overview: After years of trying to leave behind the traumas that marked their lives, a couple decides to start over in an old house far from the city. Boundaries between memory, guilt, and the supernatural begin to disappear.

title: Marble Tears Taste Like Wine
overview: A volatile chess prodigy struggling with anger management attempts to navigate a world that feels hostile, dismissive, and chaotic. While chess offers him control and identity, real life repeatedly provokes his buried rage. After fleeting moments of connection and hope, a final altercation spirals into irreversible violence, forcing him to confront the devastating cost of losing control.

title: The Obelisk
overview: While fighting for survival in the wilds of the Northeast, a drifter unites with a mysterious veteran to expose the truth of America’s demise.

title: Larger than Life
overview: A documentary following Connor Sanderson, the inspirational coach of Salisbury Ladies FC. Born with sacral agenesis, Connor has overcome physical challenges to pursue his passion for football, becoming a respected coach and an inspiration to his players and community.

title: Sincerely, Victor
overview: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

title: Faust
overview: Three artists across three generations are haunted by the demon Mephistopheles in an absurdist reconstruction of the Faustian legend.

title: Atelo
overview: After a brutal race, Damian and Amelia attempt to escape with the blood money they stole.

title: Wrong Answer
overview: A young man is tested when being asked an unknown question. What will happen if he answers wrong?

title: Dead & Breakfast
overview: A paranormal consultant, Danielle Stanbreaker,  investigates a strange supernatural occurrence at a local Bed and Breakfast that ultimately ends up being real.

title: Living Corpse
overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

title: Hallway Monitor
overview: George's sister is sick. Trying his best to take care of her, the twelve year old boy spends all hospital visits inspecting the hallway for anything that might put her in danger. When his routine inspection is interrupted, George must face the danger all around him.

title: The Dendrill
overview: While preparing their childhood home for sale, Mark reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Francis, who insists the forest never forgot them.

title: Goodbye, Monster
overview: A 12-year-old boy receives one final visit from the creature under his bed, forcing him to confront fear, loss, and the emotional cost of growing up.

title: The Man in the Second Story Window
original_title: The Man in the Second Story Window
overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

title: Taboo Cocoon
overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

title: The Cocaine Diaries
overview: Two incompetent teenagers, Sammy and Tim, are entrusted with a bag of cocaine to keep safe for the day. To them it seems simple, that is until they begin to realise that everyone and everything seems to be trying their best to get in their way.

title: Hollow Trees
overview: Years after a devastating war, a hardened survivor and a young boy are forced from their home by a creature capable of imitating humans. As they journey north in search of refuge, their fragile bond is pushed to its limits.

title: O Little Christmas Market
overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

title: If You Can Make It Here
original_title: If You Can Make It Here
overview: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

title: NAXOS
overview: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

title: Lads Being Lads
overview: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

title: All the Queens Houses
overview: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

title: The Isolate Thief
overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Down the Long River
overview: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

title: The Sound of The Mountains
overview: Through the eyes of a silent witness in the mountains of Kurdistan, four colorful hands unite in the sunlight, creating a powerful visual metaphor for a resilient nation's survival and identity.

title: Laundry day lovers
overview: In conversation over dirty clothes, Paul and Ed air out their true feelings for one another.

title: 4 Minutes Before Forever
overview: What starts as harmless fun with a voice assistant becomes a countdown to destruction when the AI begins predicting a couple's relationship's demise with terrifying precision.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: Evil Dead Burn
overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

title: Boy
overview: While housesitting alone, Danny invites an older stranger over for a casual hookup. The charged encounter pushes Danny out of his comfort zone and into a world of confusion, forcing him to face the mismatch of who he is and who he appears to be.

title: Killa Gorilla from Outer Space
overview: An alien gorilla from space comes down to kill Fergus Samsonite. Hilarity ensues.

title: The Bay
overview: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: Source Connection
overview: When an investigative reporter shows up to meet her source, he proves reticent at first, but then gives the information she's looking for. Together they're working to uncover the ills of the city.

title: Riff Raff!
overview: A grimly fiendish Sunday league manager engages in an argument over the worth of winning and losing with the league's weary referee, all whilst the manager's squad of droogs set out to sabotage that morning's match.

title: You're Just Tired
overview: Feeling isolated, lonely, and bored, new mother Lydia struggles to grasp what's real and what's her imagination.

title: Mommy, Where Did I Come From?
original_title: Mommy, Where Did I Come From?
overview: An animated parody of the lifecycle of an Alien Xenomorph.

title: There's a Visitor at the Door
original_title: There's a Visitor at the Door
overview: An inn receives a strange visitor in the middle of the night.

title: Whisper of the Well
overview: On a moonlit night, a woman unjustly condemned returns as a dark tale of vengeance, altering the fate of a quiet village.

title: Matchmaker
overview: A woman desperately searching for love goes on a date with her AI device.

title: The Worm Charmers
overview: In a rural English village, a group of enthusiasts take part in the annual worm-charming championships in a desperate attempt for local immortality.

title: Fox & the Tiny Demon
overview: Qaqsoss naka Wahantuhsis is an animated allegory about Qaqsoss, a fox who is haunted by Wahantuhsis, a tiny demon. Set in an enchanted forest, the film explores themes of mental illness, trauma, and generational pain through Qaqsoss' struggles with both her inner demons and the mischievous demon that follows her. As Qaqsoss faces her fears, she discovers resilience and growth. Ultimately, the story intertwines Indigenous culture and personal experience, showcasing the importance of self-healing and the understanding of others. The film, told in Wolastoqey, is a poignant exploration of survival and connection.

title: The Suicide Hour
overview: A detective investigates the murders of several townspeople.

title: The Okapi
overview: Deep in the wilderness, a Congolese refugee’s unresolved legal status slowly unravels his bond with his well-meaning partner.

title: Hold It Together
overview: On her weekly trips to the swimming pool, Neema, a young immigrant to Iceland, stads out so much that she melts into a puddle. As she strives to stay solid, she realises that she is not the only one struggling with loneliness and grief.

title: Stan Lee: The Final Chapter
overview: An insider look at Stan Lee's tumultuous final years, revealing how mistreatment and conflict threatened his life and legacy.

title: Blood Orange
overview: An anxious woman goes about her day as normal, but nothing seems to be going her way.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Landship
overview: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Palm
overview: In South Los Angeles, a palm tree caretaker faces the quiet unraveling of his work and identity.

title: THE CAGE WITHIN
overview: A true fight isn’t fought in the ring, but inside the mind.  The Cage Within follows Jake, a young fighter struggling with anger, trauma and the weight of expectations, as he tries to break the cycle of violence that shaped him. Between training, silence and fractured relationships, the film observes a man who chooses not to become what hurt him — even when that choice hurts more.  An intimate, restrained drama about masculinity, control and the quiet cost of change.

title: Beliath
overview: What begins as a routine crime report soon spirals into a descent through eerie folklore, buried cults, and unsettling discoveries that blur the line between journalism and obsession.

title: Prurience Executed
overview: A sexually obsessed and oppressed priest stalks a group of four young women in a park and watches them perform a pagan ritual. Eventually, his arousal for the women turns to hatred and he attacks. The women are left with no choice but to defend themselves.

title: Oliver West
overview: West Knight secretly helps Oliver, a ghost only she can see, cross over to the afterlife before his spiritual essence deteriorates completely. While her step sibling Jaime navigates a new romance with coworker Quinn, West discovers that Oliver's unfinished business isn't about supernatural rituals—it's about experiencing human connection and love.

title: Four Itchy Boys
overview: Four young men quarantined for a unexplainable, unrelenting itch prepare for a live-stream press event to prove they’re not the monsters the world believes them to be. But behind the scenes, a ruthless producer is plotting a more grotesque spectacle.

title: Symbiosis
